checks.message: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.3 (Plow) on x86_64 meets the spec.
31.3 GiB found, 32 GiB needed, inside the 5% tolerance
notes: Machines sold with a nominal size show a little less than that size, so the spec allows a small shortfall (tolerance_percent).

checks.message: `/var/lib/acme` has 100 GiB free on `/var` (xfs). 20 GiB is needed.
notes: rdy runs as root. Free space is what other users can use. Blocks reserved for root are not counted.

checks.message: Kernel `5.14.0-362.el9.x86_64` meets the minimum of 5.4. All 3 required modules are loaded or built in. BTF type information is present.
cgroup v2 in use, controllers `cpu`, `memory`, `io` and `pids` available
4 kernel parameters have the wanted value and are set at boot. Services get an open files limit of 1048576 (`DefaultLimitNOFILE=1048576` in `/etc/systemd/system.conf.d/10-acme.conf`).
notes: Read 2 sysctl configuration file(s), in boot order.
rdy's own open files limit is 1024 (soft) and 524288 (hard). That is a shell limit and does not apply to services.

checks.message: SELinux is enforcing. AppArmor is off.
Clock is synchronized, under 1 ms away from chrony's reference `192.0.2.30`.
No known security software process was found among 6 processes.
notes: rdy sees the processes of the machine it runs on. In a container, host processes are not visible.

checks.message: containerd 1.7.13 is running (cgroup driver systemd, storage driver overlayfs).
firewalld zone public allows 6443/tcp and 10250/tcp inbound.
